mentions.name: Safe Drive
mentions.description: A mobile app for the author's car that gives feedback on their driving along a familiar daily route. It identifies where they tend to brake hard and where they drive smoothly, and warns a few seconds in advance with prompts like "Warning: Often you perform hard brake in this region". Still in an early stage; the author is also exploring hardware parts to gauge how far objects are on either side of the car, with a possible later step of using OpenAuto on a Raspberry Pi.
mentions.problem: The author learned to drive only a couple of years ago and lacks objective feedback about their driving on a repeated daily route, such as where they brake hard, and wants help gaining confidence while driving.
mentions.source_excerpt: Safe Drive - Mobile app for my car. I learned driving couple of years back only. Everyday, I travel same route. So decided to create a small mobile app first, which will provide me feedback about my driving. eg. which part of the route im doing hard brake, which area im driving smoothly. etc. app will warn me few seconds in advance like "Warning: Often you perform hard brake in this region" etc.
